edge.doc: edge fallback, used mainly for ores

speedMultiplier.doc: Multiplies unit velocity by this when walked on.

dragMultiplier.doc: Multiplies unit drag by this when walked on.

damageTaken.doc: Damage taken per tick on this tile.

drownTime.doc: How many ticks it takes to drown on this. 0 to disable.

walkEffect.doc: Effect when walking on this floor.

walkSoundVolume.doc: Volume of sound made when walking.

walkSoundPitchMin.doc: Volume of sound made when walking.

walkSoundPitchMax.doc: Volume of sound made when walking.

drownUpdateEffect.doc: Effect displayed when drowning on this floor.

status.doc: Status effect applied when walking on.

liquidDrop.doc: liquids that drop from this block, used for pumps.

liquidMultiplier.doc: Multiplier for pumped liquids, used for deep water.

overlayAlpha.doc: for liquid floors, this is the opacity of the overlay drawn on top.

supportsOverlay.doc: whether this floor supports an overlay floor

shallow.doc: shallow water flag used for generation

blendGroup.doc: Group of blocks that this block does not draw edges on.

oreDefault.doc: Whether this ore generates in maps by default.

wall.doc: Wall variant of this block. May be Blocks.air if not found.

decoration.doc: Decoration block. Usually a rock. May be air.

canShadow.doc: Whether units can draw shadows over this.

forceDrawLight.doc: If true, this floor ignores the obstructsLight flag of overlays.

needsSurface.doc: Whether this overlay needs a surface to be on. False for floating blocks, like spawns.

allowCorePlacement.doc: If true, cores can be placed on this floor.

wallOre.doc: If true, this ore is allowed on walls.

blendId.doc: Actual ID used for blend groups. Internal.

tilingVariants.doc: If >0, this floor is drawn as parts of a large texture.

autotile.doc: If true, this floor uses autotiling; variants are not supported. See https://github.com/GglLfr/tile-gen

autotileMidVariants.doc: If >1, the middle region of the autotile has random variants.

autotileVariants.doc: Variants of the main autotile sprite.

drawEdgeIn.doc: If true (default), this floor will draw edges of other floors on itself.

drawEdgeOut.doc: If true (default), this floor will draw its edges onto other floors.
